summary: Fix the dead hover preview on the right column. #preview was hidden with opacity:0 only, so the invisible box kept its size, z-index and pointer-events:auto and stayed where it last appeared — to the right of a left-column card, i.e. over the right column — swallowing its mouseover events. It is now visibility:hidden + pointer-events:none unless shown, and hidePreview() parks it at (0,0).
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 777a8a4. Static UI CSS/JS only; no model call.

budget_impact.rationale: CSS/pointer-events correction only; no model call, no operation or ceiling change.
budget_impact.before: An invisible full-size preview box intercepted hover events over the right column.
budget_impact.after: Hidden preview is non-interactive and parked at the origin; only the shown preview receives events.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; UI fix, not recommendation quality

open_risks: Not visually confirmed by the agent; the owner should verify the right column.
Recommendation quality remains unproven; gates stay not_run.
